name: Botswana National Museum and Art Gallery
subtitle: The national museum in central Gaborone, with collections of traditional crafts and southern African fine art.

facts.label: Holdings
facts.value: Traditional crafts and southern African fine art

parts.text: The national museum in central Gaborone, with collections of traditional crafts and southern African fine art. It also includes the National Art Gallery, the Octagon Gallery and, since 2007, the National Botanical Garden.
